stages: The ID Team Manager creates an epic for a course in the pipeline. What gets created underneath depends on the Course Type field: Instructional, Informational and Practical courses produce Business Specs and a Course Brief, while Certification courses produce Template Generation instead. The ID Team Manager then moves the epic from To Do to In Progress and assigns it to an Instructional Designer.
Epic created, Course Type = Instructional / Informational / Practical

The Instructional Designer creates and names the topic, the primary child item under an epic. Every field except Topic is copied down from the epic, which is why the epic has to be filled in properly first. Final Slides and Articulate Review Link get added later, and must be added on the CDLC: Topic so they cascade to everything created after it.
Topic created, Course Type = Informational / Instructional / Practical
ID starts work on Final Slides
CDLC: Topic moves To Do → Final Slides
Instructional Designer, then QA and SME

The Instructional Designer develops the content against the approved learning objectives, then passes it for review. The reviewer is identified by the status: Quality review means it sits with the QA Specialist, Internal SME review means it sits with the Internal SME. Output is an Excel or Google Sheet.
CDLC: Topic Final Slides marked Done
CDLC: Topic Graphics and CDLC: Topic PPT Generation

For Instructional, Practical and Informational courses the ID generates a PPT, which Digitization turns into a Base Articulate file, the template for the final Storyline file, carrying voiceover, captions and slide titles. Its Description field arrives pre-filled with instructions for the Digitization team. The Digitization Manager assigns it onward to Data Entry, then back to the ID, who closes it. For Certification courses the ID works on Slide Chunks instead. This runs alongside Stage 5.
CDLC: Topic PPT Generation marked Done
CDLC: Base Articulate file creation, assigned to the Digitization Manager
Certification: Graphic Definitions, assigned to the ID
Visual Designer, or ID for Certification

For Informational, Instructional and Practical courses the Visual Designer works the graphics into the Articulate Storyline file built in Stage 4, following the Graphic Definition the ID wrote in the Final Slides sheet. The VD adds the Articulate Review Link, completes the checklist, sends it to the VD Team Manager, who passes it to the ID with the status Send to Instructional Designer. Anything the ID wants changed goes through CDLC: Topic Corrections, which bounces between ID and VD. For Certification courses the ID prepares the Graphic Definition instead.
parent CDLC: Topic moves to Ready for Graphics
CDLC: Articulate Review and CDLC: Topic Corrections; parent Topic moves to In Review and its Articulate Review Link is filled from the Graphics field

The ID and VD have both finished with the Storyline file and share it for review. Status moves In Progress → In Review, and back again for corrections, with the Assignee changing hands each time a concern is raised or resolved. CDLC: Topic Assessment is the last step that needs the Instructional Designer, who is both Assignee and Reporter on it.
CDLC: Topic Translations and CDLC: Topic Assessment
Creates work types SME Review and External Review
Both are statuses, not work types, no such work types exist

Two things run here. Translation: once the ID uploads the finalised Storyline file, the Digitization Resource translates it to Spanish, the Digitization Manager routes it to the course's QA Specialist, and after QA it goes to Upload to AWS and then Done, each of which drags the parent Topic along with it. Digitization: the moment the epic moves to Digitization, a fan of tickets is created, each setting off further automations as it closes. Outputs are the Planning Link on guroo.com and the Production Link on skillcat.app.
Badge and Course Image Creation, Upload to AWS + Planning, Review, Restore on SkillCat, Data Sheet Creation, Course Metadata and Create Course Introduction
CDLC: Generate Performance Report marked Done
Digitization - Restore on SkillCat marked Done
Digitization - Course Catalog Updating and CDLC: Run Image Archiving Automation
CDLC: Run Image Archiving Automation marked Done
CDLC: Topic Translations moves to Upload to AWS
parent CDLC: Topic moves to Uploading to AWS
parent CDLC: Topic moves to Done
Translation path To Do → In Progress → In Review → Upload to AWS → Done
CDLC: Topic Translations has no In Progress status. Its set includes Assigned, In Translation and Complete checklist, none of which the SOP mentions
roles: Drafting, editing and iterating content in line with the brief
Creating visuals and graphics aligning with the Instructional Designer's brief
Reviewing content for accuracy, tone, grammar and brand alignment
Creating translations and ensuring the course and all its assets upload correctly to the app
Providing specialist input and validating factual accuracy. Can be internal or external
